assumptions.dayBoundary: Local sunrise (panchangam value prevailing at sunrise defines the calendar day)
assumptions.note: Astronomically computed. May occasionally differ by ±1 day from a specific temple's published panchangam near tithi/nakshatra boundary edge cases.

events.name: Makara Vilakku
events.basis: First day of Tamil month Thai (Makara Sankranti)
events.description: Culmination of the Mandala-Makaravilakku pilgrimage season at Sabarimala, marked by the sacred light seen on the Ponnambalamedu hill at dusk.
events.significance: One of Sabarimala's most significant days each year, drawing millions of Ayyappa devotees.

events.name: Mandala Kalam Begins
events.basis: First day of Tamil month Karthigai (Malayalam Vrischikam)
events.description: Start of the 41-day Mandala Vratham observed by Ayyappa devotees before the Sabarimala pilgrimage: black or blue attire, going barefoot, celibacy, and daily temple visits.
events.significance: The most widely observed vratham among Ayyappa devotees across South India, leading up to Makara Vilakku.
